Diminish areas of vulnerability. Maximize your defenses without need to strike.|Lakshay to Jedi trainees|audio=Lakshay-Instructions-Day.flac|}} '''Lakshay''' was a [[human]] member of the [[Jedi Order]] who was apprentice to [[lightsaber]] virtuoso [[Vo'ren Faalo]] before becoming a [[Jedi Master]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]], he oversaw a class of [[Padawan]]s [[Jedi training|training]] in [[lightsaber combat]] in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], asking the students [[Daro (Jedi)|Daro]] and [[Rena]] to stay behind and show their opening stances at the end of the class. ==Biography== {{Quote|That's our time. Daro, Rena, I want to see your opening stance before you leave.|Lakshay|audio=Lakshay-SessionEnd-Day.flac|}} [[File:LakshayClass-Day.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=On a Jedi Temple training veranda with a view over the Coruscant cityscape, Master Lakshay—wearing a white robe—stands amidst a group of Jedi Padawans practicing with wooden bokken lightsabers in golden and white tunics. The Theelin-human hybrid Jecki Lon stands at the front of the group.|Master Lakshay trained Jedi Padawans such as Jecki Lon in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.]] Lakshay was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] member of the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. He was apprenticed to the [[lightsaber]] virtuoso [[Vo'ren Faalo]] and later continued in his footsteps by [[Jedi training|training]] [[Jedi]] of all ages in [[time]]-tested techniques as a [[Jedi Master]]. In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} he oversaw a class of seven [[Padawan]]s as they trained in [[lightsaber combat]] with [[wood]]en [[bokken saber]]s{{Acolyte|Day (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}} on a training veranda in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' [[Coruscant]]. As the group practiced, Lakshay walked between them and gave instructions on movement, advising the students to reduce their areas of vulnerability and maximize their defenses with tight and subtle movements but without needing to strike. As the Padawans finished their routine, a chime sounded, and Lakshay announced the end of the session. Tucking away their [[weapon]]s, the class bowed to the Jedi Master, who returned the gesture and then asked the students [[Daro (Jedi)|Daro]] and [[Rena]] to remain behind and show their opening stances. Former Jedi [[Verosha Aniseya]], who had watched Lakshay lead the class, stopped the Padawan [[Jecki Lon]] as she left the Jedi Master's classroom, and the pair spoke in the doorway as Lakshay worked with Daro and Rena. ==Personality and traits== Lakshay had light skin, [[Color|red]] [[hair]], and hazel [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== While training the Padawans, Lakshay wore a set of white and gold [[Jedi apparel|Jedi]] [[temple robes]] with a brown [[belt]] on which hung his silver-[[Lightsaber hilt|hilted]] lightsaber. ==Behind the scenes== Lakshay was portrayed by [[Paul Bullion]] and first appeared in "[[Day (episode)|Day]]," the fourth episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 18]], [[2024]], on [[Disney+]].{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} The scenes in the Jedi Temple were shot at [[Shinfield Studios]],{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}} [[Wikipedia:England|England]].{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}} Prior to the release of the episode, the character was revealed in a trailer exclusively shown at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]]{{CelebrationTrailer|''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''|Celebration Europe (2023)}} during the [[Lucasfilm]] Studio Showcase on [[April 7]], [[2023]].{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-lucasfilm-studio-showcase|text=SWCE 2023: 11 Highlights from Lucasfilm's Studio Showcase}} Lakshay was then
